Student visa

Money you need

You must have enough money to pay for your course and support yourself in the UK.

How much money you need depends on where you will be studying. You will need either:

  • £1,334 per month (for up to 9 months) for courses in London
  • £1,023 per month (for up to 9 months) for courses outside London

You must show you have had the money for at least 28 consecutive days. The end date of the 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply for your visa.
